subject: 1093年大理国低密院落（建筑细部待考）
prompt: Generate a SINGLE orthographic map building sprite on a TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA background. Reference is camera/material guide only. Camera yaw45 elevation30; exact 2:1 dimetric ground axes screen slopes+0.5,-0.5. Rectangular footprint 10m east-west by8m north-south, ground east-west edge appears1.25 times north-south edge. South entrance LOWER LEFT. One low-density residential courtyard in Dali kingdom1093, low gray tiled main timber house at rear and one side wing, low plain courtyard walls, timber south gate, mostly compacted earth court with a few stepping stones and one small camellia. Modest pale plaster, weathered timber, gray tile, simple restrained roofs. Flat thin footprint, complete clear three bottom corners, no thick plinth. Entire sprite centered with10% empty transparency all sides, no clipped eaves. Lighting screen upper left, short contact shadow lower right. No background environment or gradient or halo. No text, no sign, no logo, no people, no modern details, no caricature, no tourism white-Bai facade or palace ornament.
